period: Financial year 2024-25 (accounting periods; provisional, uplifted by HMRC for claims not yet received)
method: Cells were read from the downloaded workbook on the access date by tools/extract_uk_firm_rd_tax_credits_tables.py and written as published text: thousands separators, HMRC's suppression marker (a '<' followed by the rounding floor), 'N/A' and blank cells are kept. None was filled from memory.

source.dataset_title: Corporate tax: Research and Development Tax Credits
source.edition: Research and Development Tax Credits Statistics: September 2026 (published 29 September 2026); Main tables 2026; claims in Company Tax returns received on or before 31 May 2026
source.rounding: All figures independently rounded to the nearest 5 or £5 million; components may not sum to totals (Cover sheet).

edition_note: The September 2026 edition is the latest on the access date and replaces the September 2025 edition (2023-24 claims). Its 2024-25 year is the first with the merged RDEC scheme (accounting periods beginning on or after 1 April 2024): HMRC notes SME-level figures for 2024-25 are not comparable with earlier years.
coverage: RD6 sector is the primary SIC 2007 code of the registered company, which may not be the sector of the R&D. RD6 gives the number and cost of claims by scheme but qualifying expenditure only in total per sector; RD4 gives expenditure by scheme only nationally. RD1 counts claims (40,325 in 2024-25) and companies (37,545) separately.
